predecessors.name: Principality of Turov and Pinsk
predecessors.text: Turov and Haradok, still ruled by Rurikids when the principality joined Lithuania

successors.name: Grand Duchy of Lithuania
successors.text: Turov, which 'non-violently joined the Grand Duchy' in the early 14th century

ledger.x: 1294 (Cliopatria's first year): Turov appears as its own principality, the Pinsk part having split off as a semi-independent appanage.
1325 (last year of Cliopatria's shape): Turov joins the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.
The principality ends as a state; its land goes to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; the Pripyat marsh frontier with Pinsk, Minsk and Galicia-Volhynia is approximate.
